games.title: Math Chess 3D
games.blurb: Vietnamese math chess on a real 3D teak table with a medieval lathe-turned set. A numbered piece walks its own value; two pieces side by side fire their arithmetic down a lit ray. Physical hops, wood knocks, soft bloom, and a between-match briefing that names progress and the next mission. Take the enemy 0, or out-score it.
games.controls: Tap a piece, then a lit square — or a chip and its gold ring to capture · arrows/WASD + Enter · V changes the view, down to a flat 2D board · Q/E turn the table · rim files A–I / ranks 1–11 · desktop Match events log · match-clear continues to the next mission · portrait on phones
